name: Briefd
audience: freelancers who collect project requirements from clients
oneLiner: Client intake without the friction: send a brief link, watch the answers arrive.
facts: Claim your workspace in one click by entering your name. No passwords and no onboarding emails.
Add a client, then generate a unique, single-use link for their project. You send it to them yourself, by email or Slack.
The client opens the link with no login and fills in their scope, budget and goals.
Your dashboard updates live while the client types.
Every brief is tied to a client profile in your dashboard, for repeat work.
dont: Do not say it sends the link for you, writes the brief with AI, or makes proposals or contracts.
angles: a new client and a messy email thread of requirements
asking the same intake questions every time
clients who will not create an account
